title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.24906v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. translated_title: 基于混合强化学习的平面果园视觉运动机器人修剪
translated_abstract: 休眠期果树修剪是一项劳动密集型工作，但对于维持现代高生产力果园至关重要。在这项工作中，我们专注于现代平面树形栽培系统的修剪——V形格架苹果树和UFO形樱桃树——其主干和主枝被培养成近似平面的树墙。我们提出了一种端到端的流水线，用于学习机器人修剪的闭环视觉运动控制器。该控制器完全使用仿真和合成生成的数据进行训练，并以零样本方式部署到真实果园中。该流水线包括：平面果园树木网格的合成生成、基于物理的果园仿真器的构建、通过运动规划自动收集成功的修剪轨迹，以及采用一种新颖的混合强化学习算法进行策略学习，该算法将离线演示与在线仿真交互相结合。控制器使用来自腕部安装的相机（原文在此处截断）的光流输入……
tldr: 提出了一种结合离线演示与在线仿真交互的新型混合强化学习端到端流水线，控制器完全基于仿真合成数据训练，即可零样本部署到真实果园，实现V形苹果树和UFO形樱桃树的闭环视觉运动机器人修剪。
en_tdlr: An end-to-end pipeline with a novel hybrid reinforcement learning algorithm combining offline demonstrations and online simulated rollouts enables a visuomotor pruning controller trained entirely in simulation to be deployed zero-shot in real planar apple and cherry orchards.
